author: kawksakka
quote:
Dan Houser is gone from Rockstar and it shows. 

This is just a cash grab, nothing else. 

At least the older GTA games had soul and passion it felt like.
Grand Theft Auto IV for example felt personal, the characters were interesting, the story was about revenge.  

It was worse than I expected, and I knew. 
13 years and 1.5 billion? The characters are poorly written, dialogue is poor. 20-25 fps while every other game on the platform gets a 60 patch, there is absolutely no excuse with all AI upscale technology. For 100$ game, this is absolutely unacceptable. There has to be rules for AAA titles to have two options, a 30 FPS mode and a performance to target 60 FPS mode no matter how much lower resolution. We are almost in 2027. Everybody else can optimize, so can you Rockstar.

I feel like Red Dead Redemption 2 was a goodbye letter from Rockstar, That is what I was afraid of. Well, it was a nice ride.
